label: events
name: Events Image Category Classification
description: Classify a non-OCR event image into one or more detailed categories based on the visible celebration, ceremony, gathering, performance, competition, or organized activity.

labels.wedding: An image primarily showing a wedding ceremony, bride and groom, wedding rituals, wedding clothing, or wedding celebration.
labels.birthday: An image primarily showing a birthday celebration with a cake, candles, gifts, balloons, or birthday decorations.
labels.party: An image primarily showing a social party with people celebrating, dancing, eating, or gathering together.
labels.festival: An image primarily showing a cultural, religious, seasonal, or public festival with crowds, decorations, rituals, or performances.
labels.concert: An image primarily showing a live music concert, musician, singer, stage performance, or audience.
labels.conference: An image primarily showing a professional conference, seminar, business event, panel discussion, or organized meeting.
labels.graduation: An image primarily showing a graduation ceremony, graduating students, academic gowns, caps, certificates, or diplomas.
labels.ceremony: An image primarily showing a formal ceremony, official function, ritual, award presentation, or organized celebration.
labels.exhibition: An image primarily showing an exhibition, trade show, art display, product showcase, or public presentation.
labels.sports_event: An image primarily showing an organized sports match, competition, tournament, race, or sporting ceremony.
labels.religious_event: An image primarily showing a religious ceremony, worship gathering, procession, prayer event, or spiritual celebration.
labels.community_event: An image primarily showing a local community gathering, fair, public celebration, charity event, or social program.
labels.parade: An image primarily showing an organized public procession with people, performers, decorated vehicles, or marching groups.
labels.award_ceremony: An image primarily showing awards, trophies, medals, winners, presenters, or a formal recognition event.
labels.public_gathering: An image primarily showing a large organized gathering, rally, public meeting, or crowd attending an event.
